translated_title: Section 22 of Oaxaca in Favor of Continuing CNTE Strike; National Leadership Defines Course of Walkout Today
original_title: Sección 22 de Oaxaca a favor de seguir huelga de la CNTE; dirigencia nacional define hoy el rumbo del paro
author: Carolina Gómez and Jessica Xantomila
meta_description: Oaxaca's Section 22 voted to continue the CNTE national strike, 6,337 to 6,162, as the national leadership meets today to define the course of the walkout.
